items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...played with Les Hite's band -- fronted Les Hite's band. [INTERVIEWEE] That's right, that's right.

ctx.x: He was with Carol Dickerson's band -- and went to New York. He made some records and then he left New York and went out to California, and played with Les Hite's band -- fronted Les Hite's band.
